rules.briefwise: A proposition is supported only when every referenced synthetic authority is present and the proposition kind is a supplied holding. Missing authority is unresolved; dicta is limited; inferences require record application; authority cannot itself prove facts.
rules.depobot: A same-speaker negation of the same act, place, and year is a contradiction only when every canonical page/line binding is intact. Uncertainty is not contradiction; a question without an answer is not an admission.
rules.pidbot: Product identity requires a shared product identifier, defendant candidate, and manufacturer record. Component, material, exposure, dose, causation, and liability remain separate dimensions. Witness belief and manual overrides cannot establish material content or causation.
rules.verdictbridge: The final stage verifies upstream canonical hashes and may not upgrade an unresolved upstream dimension. Any source-binding failure, missing authority, product mismatch, unsupported injection, altered intermediate record, or unresolved dose/causation prevents VERDICT_READY.

synthetic_fixture_notice: Every authority, transcript entry, exhibit, product, entity, and conclusion is a synthetic test fixture.
canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false; stage hash excludes canonical_record_sha256 and final hash excludes final_chain_sha256.
non_claims: No real legal correctness, filing readiness, product identification, exposure, dose, causation, liability, independent fresh-generation provenance, external verification, or production deployment is established.
